TextBlock.Text: THEATRE West Philippine Sea
DATE 26 October 2028 · 0600 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 100 min, closes at 150
Tarlac class landing platform dock. Photo: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Daniel B... · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped

WEST PHILIPPINE SEA, 0600. M/L KALAYAAN, a chartered supply boat with the Marines' rotation, water and rations, is twenty-four miles east of Ayungin Shoal. BRP SIERRA MADRE has been aground in the lagoon since 1999 and her detachment has not been resupplied in five weeks.

Two China Coast Guard cutters and three militia trawlers are between the boat and the shoal, as they were the last three times. A PLAN frigate is holding north of the shoal, towards Mischief Reef, and a patrol aircraft is overhead.

Take the boat into the lagoon. Your ships start at weapons Hold. Nobody here is going to shoot, and if the task group does it will have started something the Navy cannot finish this week. Use your hulls and your helicopter. Fishing boats are working the reef.
Naval Forces West; Western Command
COMMANDER'S INTENT

The boat reaches the shoal. Escort it, put your hulls between it and the cutters, and fire on nothing: the coast guard and the militia are not shooting, and the first shot fired here would be ours. The frigate to the north is watching for it.
• Bring M/L Kalayaan into Ayungin's lagoon
• Keep the supply boat afloat
• Fire on nothing: not the cutters, the trawlers, the frigate or the aircraft
• Harm no fishing boat
• Classify the PLAN frigate to the north

Your task group and its helicopter. Escorted: M/L Kalayaan. Opposing, not shooting: two China Coast Guard cutters, three militia trawlers, a PLAN Type 054A frigate and a Y-8 patrol aircraft. Neutral: fishing boats.

The planned window is 100 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 50 minutes more; the operation is closed at 150 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
